confidence_notes: Coffee, beer and the mid-range meal rest on aggregated Numbeo and Expatistan figures in BRL (listed as Nov 2026). I saw them only in web-search summaries, not by opening the pages. They were cappuccino about R$10.5-11, domestic draft beer about R$9, and a mid-range meal for two about R$200. I converted BRL at an assumed rate of about R$5.3 per USD that I did not look up, so USD values carry roughly 5-8% FX risk. The inexpensive meal (about R$36) blends a modelled cost-of-living site's figure of about R$30 with typical Numbeo ratios. The cocktail rests on one Expatistan item (about R$21), nudged up. No per-glass wine price was found, so the wine glass is set at about 2.2 times beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked, and could run higher in the July school-holiday peak. The RBA rate comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page.
comparable_city_reasoning: Foz do Iguaçu is a mid-sized Paraná tourism gateway for Iguaçu Falls. Its food and drink prices sit near other interior southern Brazilian cities; Expatistan comparison titles list it as about the same as Cascavel and about 9% above Ponta Grossa. Hotel prices are lifted by steady domestic and international tourism.
